title: Osteomyelitis, lupus and blistering skin disease
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's condition (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint: Pain in right foot.

HPI: Pt is a 75-year-old female presenting for f/u of chronic osteomyelitis of the right foot. Pt reports persistent aching and discomfort in the calcaneus. Hx of old puncture wound to the same area. Pt has been on long-term antibiotics for this condition. Denies fever, chills, or new drainage. Reports compliance with current med regimen.

Medication List:
- Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125mg BID
- Acetaminophen 650mg PRN

Exam:
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, oriented x3.
Vitals: BP 132/78, HR 74, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% RA.
Right Foot: Localized tenderness over calcaneus. No erythema, warmth, or drainage noted. Skin intact.
Neuro: Sensation intact to light touch.

Assessment:
1. Chronic osteomyelitis of the right foot. Stable on current long-term antibiotics.

Plan:
- Continue current antibiotic regimen.
- F/u in 4 weeks for reassessment of right foot.
- Advised to notify office if increased pain or signs of systemic illness occur.

Electronically signed,
E. Castillo, DO
10/14/2026
